shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && ls -R .agents | head -50 && cat AGENTS.md && git ls-files && ls

cat package.json src/App.tsx src/main.tsx tsconfig.json; ls __agent_eval__; head -60 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; grep -n -i -C3 "i18n" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -80
ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/; for p in node_modules/@gravity-ui/*/package.json; do node -e "const p=require('./$p');console.log(p.name,p.version)"; done

sed -n 305,320p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -80; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/build; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/README.md | head -200

.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit configure Lang SegmentedRadioGroup Select Text Card Flex Button TextInput 2>&1 | head -60; grep -rn "lang\|Lang" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/utils/configure.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/build/esm/index.d.ts | head -80

bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit configure SegmentedRadioGroup Text Card Flex Button Pagination 2>&1 | head -60; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/utils/configure.d.ts; sed -n 80,140p node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/build/esm/index.d.ts; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md

grep -n -i -C5 "configure\|i18n" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md | head -60; curl -s -m 20 https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/7/llms.txt -o /tmp/uikit7.txt; wc -c /tmp/uikit7.txt; head -c 300 /tmp/uikit7.txt

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && cat SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroupOption.d.ts 2>/dev/null; ls SegmentedRadioGroup; grep -n "variant\|color" Text/Text.d.ts text/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; ls | grep -i -E "^(text|card|layout|flex)"; grep -rn "useLang\|subscribeConfigure\|getConfig" ../hooks ../utils --include=*.d.ts | head; ls ../hooks | head -50

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && grep -n -A12 "interface ControlGroupProps" components/types.d.ts; grep -n "configure\|Lang" index.d.ts utils/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null; grep -n -B2 -A4 "view?\|type?\|size?" components/Card/Card.d.ts | head -40; grep -n "TextColor\|'primary'" components/Text/colorText/colorText.d.ts | head; grep -n "gap?\|direction?\|alignItems?\|justifyContent?\|wrap?" components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts; ls components/Pagination components/Dialog 2>/dev/null | head -3; ls components/Label components/Pagination >/dev/null && echo ok

grep -n "CardView\|CardType\|CardSize" components/Card/Card.d.ts | head -5; cat components/Text/colorText/colorText.d.ts | head -30; cat components/Pagination/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40; ls components/Pagination; grep -rn "i18n\|keyset" components/Pagination/i18n/*.json 2>/dev/null | head; ls components/Pagination/i18n
cat components/Pagination/i18n/en.json components/Pagination/i18n/ru.json; grep -rln "subscribeConfigure" . | head; grep -rn "React.memo\|memo(" components/Pagination | head

cat components/theme/useLang.js i18n/i18n.js; grep -n "useLang" index.d.ts components/theme/index.d.ts components/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null; cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npm install @gravity-ui/i18n@1.8.0 2>&1 | tail -3; grep i18n package.json

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && grep -n "lang\|Lang" components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts components/theme/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null; grep -n "theme" components/index.d.ts | head -3
